articles.title: Harry Styles Shouts-Out Ex Taylor Swift’s Wedding During Madison Square Garden Show
articles.summary: On the opening night of his 30-concert residency at Madison Square Garden, pop superstar Harry Styles paid tribute to the late, great Dolly Parton. And at the tail end of Saturday night’s show, he shouted-out his ex-girlfriend Taylor Swift’s wedding to Travis Kelce.

articles.title: Owner of ‘Heated Rivalry’ Cabin Needed to Do Some ‘Soul Searching’ Before Inviting the Show Back for Season 2
articles.summary: Michael Kutryk, the owner of the now-famous cabin featured in “Heated Rivalry” Season 1, said he needed to do some “soul searching” before allowing the HBO production to come back for Season 2. “I did a little bit of soul searching about allowing them to come back,” Kutryk told HGTV.
body: Kutryk’s house was featured in the “Heated Rivalry” Season 1 finale, titled “The Cottage,” in which Shane Hollander ( Hudson Williams ) brings Ilya Rozanov ( Connor Storrie ) to his remote family cabin for a private getaway. Kutryk, a Toronto doctor, said he was shocked when he first listened to Rachel Reid’s “Game Changer,” on which the show is based, on audiobook.

“My jaw just dropped as I listened. The pretty explicit nature of the book made me wonder just what they’d be filming … and showing!” Kutryk said. “I just thought, OK, they’re gonna film what they’re gonna film. What’s done is done.”

“We’ll see after Season 2 airs what demand is like,” he added. “It’s still true: I’m a private guy. This is my retreat. I built this to get away from the world, so I don’t know how much longer I’ll continue to share it.”

“Heated Rivalry” Season 2, which was greenlit in December 2025, is expected to release in April 2027. The HBO Max and Crave series follows up-and-coming professional hockey stars Shane Hollander and Ilya Rozanov, who maintain a facade as fierce competitors on the ice while engaging in a secret romance.

articles.title: ‘Borges and Me’ Review: Gentle, Nostalgic Literary Road Movie Is More Perky Than Poetic
articles.summary: American author Jay Parini’s 2020 memoir “Borges and Me: An Encounter” read as a charming extension of an anecdote any writer would dine out on for the rest of their life: the tale of how Parini, as a college student in the 1970s, was somehow partnered on a winding road trip through the Scottish…
body: Revered Argentine writer Jose Luis Borges is rendered a colorful, quirky agent to a young writer's creative and romantic awakening in Marc Turteltaub's amiable, loosely biographical film.

Audiences might relate to some extent. In a sprightly performance rife with oddball mannerisms, Gnecco gives Borges equal parts impish wisdom, earthy vulgarity and childlike wonder, rarely letting a moment’s silence go unfilled with eager chatter. When the virginal Parini — who thus far has read romantic poetry without truly feeling it — hits it off with smart, kindly pub worker Ailith (a wonderful Freya Mavor) and they steal away for a time, the film positively breathes in the old man’s absence.

articles.title: This Short-Lived '60s Western Series Starred One Of Hollywood's Busiest Actors
articles.summary: Many actors make their mark on the industry with consistent, supporting work, but it's great when they get the chance to star like in this 1960s Western series.
body: You likely haven't heard of "Cimarron Strip," and that's just fine. "Cimarron Strip" was a short-lived Western series that aired on CBS for 23 episodes in 1967 and 1968. Unlike most shows of the day, it was a 90-minute program that followed the struggles of Marshal Jim Crown (Stuart Whitman), who has been placed in quite an awkward position. "Cimarron Strip" takes place in 1880 on a contested strip of land between the then-border of Kansas and the First Nations people's land. The local Kansan settlers are waiting for the government to grant them title to their land, and Jim Crown has arrived to tell them that Washington won't do that and that their leases have all been revoked.

Naturally, this sparks a wave of violent resentment from the local cattlemen, and Jim Crown finds he is the only marshal in town, and that the army has abandoned him. Historically, the strip of land in question would eventually become the Oklahoma panhandle, and was notoriously ungoverned for about a decade. "Cimarron Strip" was wise to set a series in this place and time.
points: Many actors make their mark on the industry with consistent, supporting work, but it's great when they get the chance to star like in this 1960s Western series.

articles.title: Heidi Montag Recalls Dolly Parton Defending Her Amid Plastic Surgery Criticism
articles.summary: "When I was at one of the hardest and most criticized moment of my life after my plastic surgery, Dolly was one of the only people in the industry who didn't take the opportunity to drag me down," 'The Hills' shared on X.
body: Heidi Montag is remembering the kindness the late Dolly Parton showed her during one of the most heavily criticized periods of her life.
Following news of Parton’s death earlier this week, Montag took to X on Friday night to pay tribute to the country music legend, recalling how Parton defended her after she underwent plastic surgery.
According to Montag, she recalled that Parton said at the time, “I had probably done the same thing if I was her age and could afford it, if I thought I needed it.”

In 2009, Montag famously underwent 10 plastic surgery procedures in one day, including breast augmentation, a nose job revision and chin reduction. She faced intense scrutiny over the procedures, with the aftermath documented on The Hills, including a heartbreaking scene in which she revealed her new appearance to her mother.
points: Heidi Montag is remembering the kindness the late Dolly Parton showed her during one of the most heavily criticized periods of her life.

articles.title: Gilligan's Island Star Jim Backus Co-Wrote A Movie Featuring One Of The Best Horror Actors Ever
articles.summary: One of the weirdest comedy films of all time was co-written by Gilligan's Island star Jim Backus. It starred a shaggy dog and... a horror legend? Sure, okay.
body: The film is a literal shaggy dog story, following a dog named Mooch ( Higgins from "Benji" and "Petticoat Junction") who aims to become a famous animal performer in movies. Mooch speaks in her own head, with a voice provided by Lynne Lipton, but many of her antics are narrated by Zsa Zsa Gabor, whom she meets on her first day in Tinselstown and receives advice from. The film is meant to be light, funny, and amusing to little, little kids. Which is bizarre, because little kids wouldn't recognize actors like Zsa Zsa Gabor, Jim Backus, James Darren, Phyllis Diller, Jill St. John, and, most startling, horror legend Vincent Price.

Price's role comes near the beginning of the film, when Mooch sees him exiting the Brown Derby. She jumps into his car, and Price is delighted to have a heckin' good pupper in the front seat with him. He drives around Beverly Hills for a bit before taking Mooch to the vet. It is there that they will part ways.
points: One of the weirdest comedy films of all time was co-written by Gilligan's Island star Jim Backus.

articles.title: Shailene Woodley Recalls Her “Dream” Role as Mary Jane Being Cut From ‘The Amazing Spider-Man 2’
articles.summary: "Spider-Man's my favorite superhero; Mary Jane was my favorite character growing up. So, when I got it, I was like, 'This is so exciting!'" the actress said before adding that she and Andrew Garfield filmed three scenes together that didn't make it into the 2014 movie.
body: Shailene Woodley is reflecting on the time her “dream” role as Mary Jane Watson was cut from The Amazing Spider-Man 2.

Speaking with the SAG-AFTRA Foundation’s Conversations recently, Woodley shared her reaction to learning that her scenes with Andrew Garfield, who starred as Peter Parker/Spider-Man, had been cut from the final film. The actress said she didn’t find out until about a year after she had finished filming the scenes for the Sony Pictures movie, which was released in theaters in May 2014.
Woodley said she was told the filmmakers planned to introduce Mary Jane after Peter’s relationship with Gwen Stacy, played by Stone, came to an end.

The Hollywood Reporter reported in 2013 that Woodley’s scenes had been cut from the film. At the time, director Marc Webb said the decision was made to streamline the story and focus on Peter and Gwen’s relationship.

The 2026 college football season kicked off on Saturday, Aug. 29 as the UNC Tar Heels faced the TCU Horned Frogs in Dublin, Ireland. As always, this year’s NCAA football games will be broadcast across a variety of networks and streaming services — See below for the full breakdown.

TV channels include ABC, ACC Network, Big Ten Network, CBS, CBS Sports Network, The CW, ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, Fox, FS1, FS2, NBC, SEC Network, TBS, TNT and truTV, which are also available to watch live on any streaming service that carries said networks, including DirecTV (with a five-day free trial ), Fubo (with a five-day free trial ), Sling and Hulu + Live TV. Networks’ accompanying streaming services also share NCAA football broadcast rights. These include ESPN Unlimited, Disney+ (two per week, as the service pushes to be seen as a live sports hub ), Paramount+, Peacock, Fox One and HBO Max.

articles.title: Before Project Hail Mary, Sandra Huller Appeared In A Deeply Underrated Sci-Fi Movie On Netflix
articles.summary: Before Sandra Hüller nabbed an Oscar nomination, she starred in this fantastic science-fiction movie with Dan Stevens that you can stream on Netflix.
body: "I'm Your Man" begins with the film's protagonist, Alma (Maren Eggert), having a conversation with a devastatingly handsome man named Tom (Dan Stevens) at a dance club. Alma asks Tom about math and poetry, odd topics to cover while at the club. When Tom asks her to dance, he begins repeating the same phrases over and over. It turns out that Tom is a high-tech android, and Alma was giving him a Turing test.

Alma, you see, has been asked to test the humanity of a new line of ultra-human robots being built to serve as ersatz romantic partners. After Tom's glitches are fixed, he is sent home with Alma, where he attempts to charm her 24 hours a day. He is her man. Sandra Hüller plays the unnamed employee of the android company that has issued Tom for testing. It's a pretty damn great movie that's currently playing on Netflix.
points: Before Sandra Hüller nabbed an Oscar nomination, she starred in this fantastic science-fiction movie with Dan Stevens that you can stream on Netflix.

articles.title: Chris Hansen Gives Robert Pattinson Credit for His “Pretty Good Imitation” in ‘Primetime’
articles.summary: Though the former 'To Catch a Predator' host said that it's also "overly dramatic."
body: Chris Hansen is speaking out again about the upcoming film Primetime, and this time, he’s giving Robert Pattinson some credit for his performance as him.
Speaking with Entertainment Tonight, Hansen, the former host of Dateline NBC’s To Catch a Predator, shared his take on The Batman star’s portrayal based on what he’s seen in the trailer.
However, Hansen added that his family has been more receptive to Pattinson’s performance.
“It’s not so much what I think; it’s what other people think. And you know, my wife [and] my family seem to think it’s a pretty good imitation,” he said.
